note: TestRFC1350ClientDallies now sets the new tftpDally (1 s) instead of tftpTimeout; the assertions are unchanged. After the final ACK 2, a resent final DATA 2 must draw ACK 2 again within tftpTimeout/2, so a client that exits at once is red. A resent older block 1 must draw nothing for 200 ms, so a dally that ACKs anything is red.
